text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-3492 — pg-primary-eu0 connections > 95% (threshold 90%). Auto-page sent to @oncall-tim and @sre-jen

oncall-tim: acked. looking now. seeing lots of CONNECTs from model-proxy-eu cluster.

sre-jen: I see pgbouncer stats: `active 980, waiting 120, max_client_conn 1100` — hitting limits. p95 db write latency spiked to 2.3s.

dave-eng: customer reports: embeddings API in eu-west returning 503s since ~08:42 UTC, likely related.

pagerduty-bot: PD escalation: if not acknowledged in 5m escalate to L2.

carla-sre: quick checklist: are replicas healthy? any recent deploys? if this is connection leakage, restarting model-proxy pods might free sockets quickly.

oncall-tim: replicas OK, replication lag < 50ms. No recent schema deploys. There was a model-serving canary pushed ~08:30 that touches kv cache.

sre-jen: running quick query to check open connections per app:
```
SELECT application_name, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle' OR state='active' GROUP BY application_name ORDER BY count DESC;
```

sre-jen: results: model-proxy-eu: 720, embeddings-worker: 260, pgbouncer: 10. model-proxy looks hot.

dave-eng: model-proxy had a rollout at 08:30 — possible regression causing per-request new DB sockets instead of pooling. rolling restart may fix.

oncall-tim: I'm going to shift a fraction of traffic to eu-fallback region to reduce pressure while we mitigate. initiating weight shift in traffic-router.

oncall-tim: command: `routectl set-weight embeddings-eu --region eu-fallback --weight 0.25`

incident-bot: automated action executed: traffic weight updated.

carla-sre: good. also bump pgbouncer max_client_conn temporarily from 1100 -> 1600 to buy time (making sure connection limits on DB instance allow).

sre-jen: bumping pgbouncer now. config applied. restarting pgbouncer-ingress (graceful).

dave-eng: restarting model-proxy-eu pods (rolling, 3 pods at a time) to recycle connections. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-proxy-eu -n prod --max-unavailable=3`

oncall-tim: restart in progress. monitoring connections and errors.

sre-jen: after first batch restart, open connections dropped from 980 -> 420. error rate on embeddings down 70%. P90 latency back to ~280ms.

pagerduty-bot: PD-3492 acknowledged by oncall-tim at 08:49 UTC.

carla-sre: note — some customers still saw 503s for elongated requests (long-running embedding generations). suggesting a retry window increase in SDK for 10m while we stabilize.

dave-eng: rolling patch queued: fix connection pool initialization bug in model-proxy (leak when conn fails handshake). CI PR: https://git.company/patches/5234

oncall-tim: will follow up with rollback safeguard: enable fallback model variant in region to avoid heavy long-tail requests hitting DB.

incident-bot: escalation timer cleared.

sre-jen: metrics look stable for 10m. pgbouncer queues < 10, DB cpu normal.

oncall-tim: handing off to carla for post-incident follow-up and postmortem. adding action items:
- short term: promote model-proxy patch to canary and monitor.
- medium: add circuit-breaker in embeddings service to reject excessive concurrent requests per user.
- long term: add synthetic canary for connection churn test during deploys.

carla-sre: got it. creating incident ticket and assigning owners. tracking severity: Sev3 (customer-impacting with partial outages for EU embeddings). I'll draft postmortem and coordinate customer comms with support.

oncall-tim: closing PD alert once all services stable. last observed 503s at 08:54 UTC.

incident-bot: PD-3492 resolved and closed by oncall-tim at 08:56 UTC.

carla-sre: postmortem checklist: include timeline, root cause (model-proxy connection pooling regression after canary), remediation (patch, pgbouncer temp bump), customer impact summary (X customers affected, Y API errors, Z minutes degraded). assigning to @dave-eng and @sre-jen for runbook updates.

sre-jen: will add runbook steps for autoscaling pgbouncer and automated pool size increase with safety checks.

dave-eng: I'll follow up with the model team about deploy gating and add a unit/integration test for pool reuse.

oncall-tim: thanks everyone. leaving this thread for the follow-up owners. :white_check_mark:
